title: Build multiscale render-supervised video-to-jewel realizer
description: Replace the cell-mean 24x40 oracle guide encoder with multiscale spatial features and cell/rank cross-attention. Train stochastic 22-D mark realization under fixed target topology with denoised-target feature loss plus differentiable sampled render, edge/chroma, and perceptual supervision. This is the next bounded gate before a pretrained prompt-generated video scaffold or free topology.
acceptance_criteria: All four group4 held-out oracle-guide renders preserve recognizable action-defining macro geometry; report PSNR, contrast, edge, saturation, temporal change, and perceptual quality against deterministic and v1 guided controls; target topology and carried jewels remain exact; target projection remains render-identical; code, companion docs, tests, GIFs, and paper/roadmap evidence are updated.

title: Upgrade Jewels report to submission-grade benchmark
description: Extend the August 2026 technical progress report into a submission paper: finish the 16-video prompt corpus, evaluate correct vs shuffled vs null text on held-out groups, run autonomous rollout and local-edit perceptual tests, compare matched baselines including VeGaS/GSVC/GaussianVideo/GaRV where appropriate, refresh the literature audit, and finalize authorship/affiliations. Coordinate with jewels-iuu for prompt-conditioned training evidence.
notes: Added the requested conceptual sections to the technical report: 'Why an Explicit Jewel Field Rather Than a Raster Latent?' and 'Jewel Fields as a Multimodal Event Language.' The first distinguishes representation from diffusion/flow/autoregressive objectives, acknowledges dense-latent advantages, states motion-noise scaling expectations, and gives explicit rejection gates. The second credits Chameleon, Emu3, and Transfusion, proposes WINDOW/CARRY/CELL/BIRTH/MARK/MOVE/SPLIT/DELETE events, and factors 16^3 coarse tokens from local continuous 22-D jewel marks. Abstract, introduction, roadmap, conclusion, references, and companion documentation were updated. Revised PDF is 14 pages with 22 references, no unresolved citations/references or overfull boxes, and affected pages were visually inspected. Submission-grade benchmark work remains open.

title: Implement persistent streaming jewel contract spike
description: Define physical-time jewel lifetimes and stable IDs, extract rolling prefix/future windows from one continuous fitted volume, carry boundary-crossing jewels without regeneration, audit active density/birth rate/lifespans, and prove deterministic carry/commit rendering has no seam. This precedes the multi-window prompt-conditioned continuation model.
notes: Persistent streaming contract implemented and validated. 69 tests pass. 45k isotropic: 2,933 effective/frame, median lifespan 5; 90k isotropic: 3,822 and lifespan 3; 90k spatial: 8,403 and lifespan 11. The continuous 96f/120k spatial fit completed in 2.00h at 33.254 dB full render, with 10,301 effective/frame (min 8,391), median/p95 lifespan 15/28, boundary carry 17.8k-20.0k, and carry/commit max error 1.19e-7. Use a 32-frame prefix for continuation because it covers p95 support.
close_reason: Stable-ID carry/commit contract, physical density/lifecycle metrics, real 90k controls, and one continuous 96-frame training target all pass.

Download the distilled LTX-2.3 checkpoint, spatial upscaler, and Gemma text encoder if access permits. Validate a minimal 512px/49-frame FP8-cast generation on the RTX 4090, record VRAM/runtime/output provenance, and expose a repeatable command for Jewels semantic-scaffold experiments.
acceptance_criteria: Official repository revision and dependency lock are recorded; model assets pass size/presence checks; one prompt produces a playable MP4 on Aine with no OOM; the invocation pins GPU, quantization, offload, seed, resolution, and frame count; integration docs identify output contract and remaining limitations.
notes:
Preflight 2026-08-09: Aine is Arch Linux with NVIDIA driver 595.71.05 / CUDA 13.2. GPUs: RTX 2070 SUPER 8GB and idle RTX 4090 24GB; 170GB free on /home. uv 0.11.16 and git 2.54.0 installed. Selected official distilled LTX-2.3 path on GPU1 with fp8-cast, expandable CUDA segments, CPU offload, and a 512px/49-frame first generation. Full dev model is out of scope for 24GB.
Installed official LTX-2 at upstream 4f8905737aac86a554637cac86c178877a39c744 in /home/m/LTX-2; uv sync completed and CUDA sees the RTX 4090/2070S. Downloaded distilled v1.1 checkpoint (46.15 GB) and spatial upscaler (1.0 GB). Deployed reproducible sol.ltx_scaffold harness; Aine-side Ruff, 3 unit tests, and the exact 512x768/49-frame dry-run pass. Remaining external gate: Hugging Face user Multiqueue receives 403 until account owner accepts Google's license for google/gemma-3-12b-it-qat-q4_0-unquantized; then download ~24.38 GB and run/inspect first MP4.
Gemma license accepted; full 18-file download completed. All five safetensor shards named by model.safetensors.index.json are present (24.38 GB decimal plus tokenizer/config files). Added one-second nvidia-smi sampling to the launch receipt; 124 local tests pass and Aine Ruff + 4 unit tests pass. Launch is safely queued as user service jewels-ltx-smoke.service behind pre-existing fable2.train PID 1801324, which currently holds 13.2 GiB on the 4090; queue additionally waits for aggregate GPU use below 2 GiB. Output target /home/m/LTX-2/outputs/jewels_horse_smoke.mp4, log /home/m/LTX-2/logs/jewels_horse_smoke.log.
close_reason: Official LTX-2.3 stack and all assets installed on Aine; bounded 768x512x49 prompt smoke completed in 179.81s at 9,329 MiB aggregate peak, producing a playable H.264/AAC MP4 with coherent horse/rider motion; reproducible launcher, tests, docs, and receipt are present.

title: Train prefix-to-future jewel continuation overfit
description: Using the 96-frame joint fitted field, encode rolling 16-frame-prefix/16-frame-future views and train a small masked conditional prior to preserve carried IDs while predicting future birth counts and jewel marks. Gate against independent-window generation on seam error, future render quality, density drift, and birth/lifespan statistics.
notes: Passed learned continuation overfit. Four 32-prefix/16-future views from the joint 96f/120k field use stable-ID carry plus learned births. Selected 0.80M cell-local model: correct feature MSE 0.4475 vs 1.1988 disjoint-shuffled and 2.1695 null; count MAE 0.3310; birth ratio 0.9995; sampled field PSNR 19.870 dB; carried max error 0.0. Cell-local context improves 3.41 dB over matched global pooling. 81 sol tests pass. Artifacts: sol/results/streaming_continuation_local/. Limits: single-clip oracle-rank overfit; held-out rollout/text remain open.

title: Write technical report on spacetime jewel video progress
description: Produce and maintain a compiled LaTeX technical report covering the additive anisotropic (u,v,t) representation, fitting, density, tokenizer, latent prior, continuation, editing, prompt-corpus results, related work, defensible novelty boundary, limitations, and next experiments.
notes: Completed a 13-page LaTeX technical progress report at paper/main.tex with 17 primary references, reproducible build instructions, repository figures, quantitative tables, falsifications, limitations, and a staged path to promptable generation. Broad first-to-reconstruct-video-with-splats claim is rejected; the narrower persistent generative/editable (u,v,t) field hypothesis remains provisional. Compiled and visually inspected output: output/pdf/jewels_progress_report.pdf.
close_reason: Report source, bibliography, documentation, and visually verified PDF completed.

title: Condition persistent jewel generation on UCF text prompts
description: After learned continuation passes, condition initial generation and future birth/update sampling on UCF class prompt templates. Require correct prompts to beat shuffled and null controls while preserving rollout density, identity, motion, and color.
notes:
All 16 prompt-corpus fits are finalized: four clean 120k-jewel checkpoints in each shard, no recovery files, consistent 96x160x213 shapes. Shards1/2/3 completed in 8.11/8.10/8.07h. Read-only 32^3 capacity preflight loads all roots, finds max occupancy 253 against 512 slots and zero overflow. Next authorized work: add deterministic motion+chroma sampling, add prompt-aware latent-cache binding, validate locally, then run a bounded shared-tokenizer smoke on 12 training sources with all four group4 sources held out. Full tokenizer and prompt prior launch only after rendered smoke gate.
Implemented and pushed deterministic 50/50 motion+chroma saliency pools and exact manifest-bound prompt latent expansion. Local sol suite passes (99 tests, 1 subtest). Four-class shared tokenizer smoke used 12 group1-3 training windows and four untouched group4 holdouts: fixed 4096-point mean/macro PSNR 15.8898, count recovery 95.7406%, all classes improved from initialization. Renders preserve coarse palette/motion but remain too diffuse for the visual gate. A fresh 3000-step run with identical split, 32^3x24 rank tokenizer, and 75% source-saliency render sampling is active on PyTorch cuda:1 / physical RTX 2070 SUPER at /home/m/jewels/tokenizer/prompt_shared_3000 (log /home/m/jewels/logs/prompt_shared_3000.log). Do not launch the prompt prior until this run is audited at 4096 points and rendered.
The fresh shared 3000-step tokenizer completed in 78.7 min. Fixed 4096-point group4 audit: 16.5407 dB mean/macro, 96.1906% count; ApplyEyeMakeup 14.853, Basketball 16.099, HorseRiding 15.445, PlayingGuitar 19.765. Built-in validation peaked at 16.989 dB at step1500 and ended 16.506. Visual gate fails: action-defining subjects remain texture/noise, so prompt-prior training stays paused. Four seen shard0 sources score 19.552 dB / 98.626% count but are still noisy, showing both a 3.012 dB generalization gap and incomplete reconstruction. Occupancy audit: mean 25,185 occupied 32^3 cells; 26.1% of jewels lie in cells with >=16 and 13.3% in cells with >=32, while one 24-D token serves each cell. Also 16.78M/21.48M model parameters (78%) are learned absolute cell embeddings, a likely diverse-scene memorization path. A bounded 1000-update overfit of v_HorseRiding_g01_c01 is active on the 2070S at /home/m/jewels/tokenizer/overfit_120k_horse_1000 to discriminate underexposure from intrinsic cell-bottleneck loss. Do not start prompt training. Next architecture candidate if needed: occupancy-adaptive local tokens plus shared deterministic 3D positional features.
Completed learned-position 1000-step HorseRiding overfit: fixed 4096-point PSNR 23.6574, count 97.604%, versus 19.552 shared seen-source mean. Render restores fence and rough horse/rider silhouette but remains noisy. Implemented checkpoint-compatible position_mode={learned,fourier}; Fourier mode requires rank encoder, replaces both 32768x256 absolute tables with shared 27-D multiscale 3D basis projections, reducing the 24-D model from 21.48M to 4.71M parameters. Added CLI/checkpoint metadata and tests; local full suite passes 101 tests + 1 subtest. Deployed pre-compatibility-refinement source to GPU and launched sequential matched 1000-step Horse controls at /home/m/jewels/tokenizer/overfit_fourier24_horse_1000 and overfit_fourier64_horse_1000; first initialized at 4.71M and 6.48GB VRAM. Further server access and git landing were blocked when the Codex external-action usage limit was reached; jobs continue independently. Next session: inspect both logs, run 4096 audits/renders, deploy the final learned-mode no-cast compatibility refinement (Fourier behavior unchanged), choose shared smoke, then land/push the dirty local worktree.
Recovered completed Fourier controls. Fixed 4096-point overfit audits: 32^3x24 Fourier 21.8217 dB / 99.184% count; 32^3x64 Fourier 21.7361 / 99.561%. Both are visually nearly identical and worse than learned-position overfit 23.6574, proving the learned tables memorized single-video content and channel width was not the solution. Implemented opt-in occupancy-balanced count loss and configurable count weight. Matched latent-number spatial sweep: 64^3x8 Fourier, enc_depth0, 2.34M params, 365s. Global count loss: 23.6555 dB / 87.705%; balanced weight0.25: 23.8141 / 93.149%; selected balanced weight0.5: 24.5861 / 97.694%, beating learned overfit by 0.929 dB and 32^3x64 by 2.85 dB. Full local suite passes 102 tests + 1 subtest; remote sparse tests pass. Launched exposure-matched shared 12000-step run at /home/m/jewels/tokenizer/prompt_shared_spatial64x8_balanced05_12000 (log /home/m/jewels/logs/prompt_shared_spatial64x8_balanced05_12000.log), 12 train / four group4 holdouts, warmup1200, eval/checkpoint2000. Initialized cleanly at 2.34M params, 6.41GB VRAM, ~0.37s/step. Prompt prior remains paused pending final 4096-point audit and all four renders. Dense 64^3 is a proxy; if it passes, implement sparse occupied fine tokens under the coarse hierarchy.
Completed exposure-matched shared 64^3x8 tokenizer: fixed group4 audit 20.7353 dB / 99.794% count; seen shard0 22.4129 / 98.405%. Both visually erase actors, so tokenizer gate fails. Implemented compact occupied-group codec/checkpoint dispatch. Horse controls: 4x32 weak-render 24.7516/100%; 2x24 24.3166/100%; 4x32 render-weight2 26.0193/100%; 1x16 upper bound 26.0869/100%. Visuals remain noisy, proving learned jewel reconstruction is the wrong critical path. Implemented direct prompt-conditioned birth trainer with text/context dropout and held-out correct/shuffled/null evaluation plus free-count renders. 3000-step 0.84M run: text-only mark MSE correct 1.1579 vs shuffled 1.1794 vs null 1.1641; counts change deterministically by action prompt and correct field PSNR beats shuffled for all four group4 classes, but videos remain washed out. 12000-step context50 strengthens correct-vs-shuffled mark margin to 3.69% while topology/null control fails. Occupied/empty-balanced scalar count regression worsens false positives. Next: factor topology into calibrated occupancy classification plus positive-count regression, retain direct 22-D jewel marks, then rerun free correct/shuffled/null render gate before initial-window generation.
Washed-out fix was re-evaluated before implementing the proposed occupancy/count split. Exact target cells/counts/ranks improve the deterministic held-out render only 14.0597 to 14.2319 dB (+0.1722); predicted geometry alone is 14.4338 dB, predicted color/gradient alone 15.2551, predicted opacity alone 24.8157. Only 39.73% of predicted centers remain in their supplied spatial cell and 25.41% in the full birth cell, so topology adherence is defective but not causal for washout. A 12k-step 1.54M oracle-topology stochastic mark flow restores raw edge energy to 84.44% and PSNR 15.0642 but yields incoherent speckle. A 12k-step 2.13M oracle-video-guide control using the true future at 24x40 reaches 16.5554 dB, 85.55% contrast, and 90.50% edge energy, +2.3236 dB over deterministic marks, with visibly restored macro-layout on all four group4 sources. Corrected hard projection preserves fitted targets at 100 dB. Decision: do not build the count head next. Build a multiscale, cross-attentive, render/perceptual-supervised video-to-jewel realizer under privileged guide/topology; then replace the oracle guide with a frozen pretrained text-to-video scaffold and only afterward learn scaffold-conditioned occupancy/counts. Full suite: 120 tests + 1 subtest pass. Paper and GIF evidence updated.
